description: p7 inject spec for WC-HAUNTED-MAIN-001 (task 7.5): a three-goal chain and every reward packet. Waypoint (compilation goal 0, re-sent), BountyCollect, Persona, each completed then removed before the next is sent; MSG_COMPLETEQUEST closes the quest after goal 2. The reward previews ride MSG_QUESTOFFER.Rewards and MSG_SENDQUEST.Rewards (gold, magic XP, an item; the send adds a spell), MSG_QUESTREWARDS carries the spell as Imlight sends it, and MSG_LOOT carries a different roll (gold, magic XP, another item), as the drop table handlers send it after MSG_COMPLETEQUEST.
